title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat in the Queues app Recap tab for recorded call queue calls
summary: Hold: the open questions incorrectly leave Copilot interaction retention, compliance search and auditing undocumented, although Microsoft publishes general rules covering these interactions. The statements that existing Queues app users will see the option also omit the required Copilot availability and recorded-call access. The roadmap facts and both control rows are supported.

claims.where: Open questions: questions and answers retention
claims.claim: Where Copilot sidecar questions and answers are retained remains unpublished.
claims.quote: Retention policies for AI apps include user prompts and responses for Microsoft 365 Copilot ... Data from generative AI messages is stored in a hidden folder in the mailbox of the user who runs the AI app.
claims.fix: Remove the retention part of the final open question: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-policies-copilot already states that Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts and responses have compliance copies in a hidden folder in the user's Exchange mailbox.

claims.claim: Whether compliance teams can search Copilot sidecar questions and answers remains undocumented.
claims.quote: Messages stored in mailboxes, including the hidden folders, are searchable by eDiscovery tools. Until messages are permanently deleted from the SubstrateHolds folder, they remain searchable by eDiscovery tools.
claims.fix: Remove 'can compliance teams search' from the final open question: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-policies-copilot documents eDiscovery search of compliance copies until permanent deletion.

claims.claim: Whether compliance teams can audit Copilot sidecar interactions remains undocumented.
claims.quote: The system automatically logs these activities as part of Audit (Standard). If your organization enables auditing, you don't need to take extra steps to configure auditing support for Copilot and AI applications.
claims.fix: Remove the auditing part of the final open question, leaving no final question after the retention and search corrections: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/audit-copilot documents automatic logging of Microsoft Copilot interactions when organisation auditing is enabled.
